privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase from Brickify.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: When you visit the Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including information about your web browser, IP address, time zone, and some of the cookies that are installed on your device.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the information we collect to help us screen for potential risk and fraud, and more generally to improve and optimize our Site.

sharing.title: Sharing Your Information
sharing.content: We share your Personal Information with third parties to help us use your Personal Information, as described above.

tracking.title: Behavioral Advertising
tracking.content: We use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: If you are a European resident, you have the right to access personal information we hold about you and to ask that your personal information be corrected, updated, or deleted.

changes.title: Changes
changes.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to our practices or for other operational, legal or regulatory reasons.

privacyPolicy.contact: If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy, please contact us.
